ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, which species receives energy from mouse?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows labeled organisms including mouse near the right-center/lower-right area and owl above/right of it. There is an arrow that goes from the mouse upward toward the owl, with the arrowhead at the owl. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate energy moving from the organism being eaten to the organism receiving/eating it. Since the arrow from mouse points to owl, the species receiving energy from the mouse is the owl.
